label: Extended feminist critique of private domination to anti-dictatorship politics
description: Drawing on feminist theory against authoritarianism, Kirkwood argued in Chile that resisting Pinochet required dismantling patriarchy inside political parties and homes alike.
dialecticalTension: Unites anti-dictatorial democratic theory with feminist domestic critique.

label: Shaped Latin American feminist democratic theory and encuentros praxis
description: Kirkwood’s formulation of feminist "knots" and autonomous mobilization directly influenced Virginia Vargas’s theorization of Latin American feminist citizenship.
dialecticalTension: Connects Chilean anti-dictatorship feminism to Peruvian and regional democratic movements.
